The modifications in `PageManager.java` are related to the handling of the current page when the last page is popped. This change addresses a bug where `mCurPage` was not being updated correctly during a transition animation, ensuring that the current page is accurately reflected even if an animation is still in progress. The removal of the previous line setting `mCurPage` indicates a restructuring of the logic to improve clarity and correctness in the page management process.
